transition.description:
Page transition, powered by Vue's `<TransitionGroup/>`

Built-in transitions:
- fade
- fade-out
- slide-left
- slide-right
- slide-up
- slide-down
- zoom-in
- zoom-out
- blur
- rise
- iris
- wipe-left
- wipe-right
- wipe-up
- wipe-down
- view-transition
- morph

A duration and an easing can follow the name, for example `zoom-in 800ms expo`.

See https://sli.dev/guide/animations.html#pages-transitions

See https://vuejs.org/guide/built-ins/transition.html

layout.description:
Slide layout to use

Default to 'cover' for the first slide, 'default' for the rest
layout.markdownDescription:
Slide layout to use

Default to 'cover' for the first slide, 'default' for the rest

class.description: Custom class added to the slide root element
class.markdownDescription: Custom class added to the slide root element

clicks.description:
Manually specified the total clicks needed to this slide

When not specified, the clicks will be calculated by the usage of v-clicks

See https://sli.dev/guide/animations
clicks.markdownDescription:
Manually specified the total clicks needed to this slide

When not specified, the clicks will be calculated by the usage of v-clicks

See https://sli.dev/guide/animations

clicksStart.description: Manually specified the total clicks needed to this slide to start
clicksStart.markdownDescription: Manually specified the total clicks needed to this slide to start

preload.description:
Preload the slide when a nearby slide is active.

Slides further than two slides from the current one are unmounted. Set to `true` to keep this slide mounted once it has loaded, for example to keep the state of an editor or a video when navigating away. Set to `false` to only load it when it becomes the current slide.
preload.markdownDescription:
Preload the slide when a nearby slide is active.

Slides further than two slides from the current one are unmounted.
Set to `true` to keep this slide mounted once it has loaded, for example
to keep the state of an editor or a video when navigating away.
Set to `false` to only load it when it becomes the current slide.

hide.description: Completely hide and disable the slide
hide.markdownDescription: Completely hide and disable the slide

disabled.description: Same as `hide`, completely hide and disable the slide
disabled.markdownDescription: Same as `hide`, completely hide and disable the slide

hideInToc.description:
Hide the slide for the `<Toc>` components

See https://sli.dev/builtin/components#toc
hideInToc.markdownDescription:
Hide the slide for the `<Toc>` components

See https://sli.dev/builtin/components#toc

title.description: Override the title for the `<TitleRenderer>` and `<Toc>` components Only if `title` has also been declared
title.markdownDescription:
Override the title for the `<TitleRenderer>` and `<Toc>` components
Only if `title` has also been declared

level.description: Override the title level for the `<TitleRenderer>` and `<Toc>` components Only if `title` has also been declared
level.markdownDescription:
Override the title level for the `<TitleRenderer>` and `<Toc>` components
Only if `title` has also been declared

routeAlias.description: Create a route alias that can be used in the URL or with the `<Link>` component
routeAlias.markdownDescription: Create a route alias that can be used in the URL or with the `<Link>` component

zoom.description: Custom zoom level for the slide
zoom.markdownDescription: Custom zoom level for the slide

clickAnimation.description: Default click animation for the slide: preset names, then an optional duration and easing, for example `up 600ms expo`
clickAnimation.markdownDescription:
Default click animation for the slide: preset names, then an optional
duration and easing, for example `up 600ms expo`

clickStagger.description: Delay between elements that appear on the same click, for example `80ms`
clickStagger.markdownDescription: Delay between elements that appear on the same click, for example `80ms`

camera.description:
Zoom and pan within the slide on clicks. Each keyframe applies from its click on.

See https://sli.dev/guide/animations#camera
camera.markdownDescription:
Zoom and pan within the slide on clicks. Each keyframe applies from its click on.

See https://sli.dev/guide/animations#camera

dragPos.description:
Store the positions of draggable elements Normally you don't need to set this manually

See https://sli.dev/features/draggable
dragPos.markdownDescription:
Store the positions of draggable elements
Normally you don't need to set this manually

See https://sli.dev/features/draggable

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds, or a CSS time such as `800ms` or `1.2s`
duration.markdownDescription: Duration in milliseconds, or a CSS time such as `800ms` or `1.2s`

easing.description: CSS easing, or one of `smooth`, `expo` and `snappy`
easing.markdownDescription: CSS easing, or one of `smooth`, `expo` and `snappy`

at.description: Click that applies this keyframe. Defaults to the click after the previous keyframe.
at.markdownDescription: Click that applies this keyframe. Defaults to the click after the previous keyframe.

target.description: CSS selector of an element in the slide to frame. Sets the zoom to fit it unless `zoom` is given.
target.markdownDescription: CSS selector of an element in the slide to frame. Sets the zoom to fit it unless `zoom` is given.

zoom.description: Scale of the view, where `1` shows the whole slide
zoom.markdownDescription: Scale of the view, where `1` shows the whole slide

x.description: Horizontal center of the view, in pixels or as a percentage of the slide such as `'25%'`
x.markdownDescription: Horizontal center of the view, in pixels or as a percentage of the slide such as `'25%'`

y.description: Vertical center of the view, in pixels or as a percentage of the slide
y.markdownDescription: Vertical center of the view, in pixels or as a percentage of the slide

duration.description: Duration of the move to this keyframe, in milliseconds or as a CSS time
duration.markdownDescription: Duration of the move to this keyframe, in milliseconds or as a CSS time

easing.description: CSS easing of the move, or one of `smooth`, `expo` and `snappy`
easing.markdownDescription: CSS easing of the move, or one of `smooth`, `expo` and `snappy`
